up-figlet: FIGlet large text banners in UP-Term:bin with the standard font in UP-Term:share/figlet

Contents: FIGlet large text banners in UP-Term:bin with the standard font in UP-Term:share/figlet
Licence: BSD-3-Clause; see LICENSES.txt.

Needs up-term.lha installed first (version 1.0 or newer). In an UP-Term window, in vsh:
  figlet

Install: run Install (Installer) or, with upkg, install up-figlet. Uninstall takes the package out
again; the UP-Term Uninstall runs it first.
